neat-photosynthesis: Plants use light energy, water and carbon dioxide to make glucose and oxygen. Chlorophyll in the leaves absorbs the light.
fast-osmosis: Osmosis is the movement of water from a dilute solution to a more concentrated one through a membrane.
crossed-out-respiration: Respiration releases energy from food. Glucose and oxygen give carbon dioxide and water. It happens in the mitochondria.
maths-working: Area = 1/2 x base x height = 1/2 x 8 x 5 = 20 cm2
